_about: The support types Analytics maps (the tools page only): those where being there in person matters most. Its Support for box offers only these (always one of them: there's no 'Anything'), starting on 'default'. The chart's title reads 'Distance to nearest in-person ___ support' with the type's name, or its word in 'title_words' where the name doesn't read well there. Each type must be one of the sheet's support types (build/core/data/support-types.json): build/tests/ checks.
